query: UPDATE central.artifacts SET version = $3, state = $4, size = $5, checksum_value = $6, checksum_algorithm = CASE WHEN $6::bytea IS NULL THEN checksum_algorithm ELSE 'sha256' END, rejection = COALESCE($7::jsonb, rejection), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $8
